integrity: Analytical proof uses exact cyclic geometric sums and finite Weyl diagonalization. The attached checker validates finite cases but does not replace the all-order proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact labelled full-grid cyclic STFT data only; real positive geometric ratio different from one; no stability claim; additional measurement is not a Gabor shift.
title: Exact phase-retrieval fibers and one-probe completion for cyclic geometric windows
